description: This file contains command implementations for sandbox management, including listing, recreating, and filtering sandbox containers and browsers, with external dependencies on sandbox agents, display functions, and runtime utilities.

methods.name: sandboxListCommand
methods.description: Lists sandbox containers or browsers based on options, outputs in JSON or display format.

methods.name: sandboxRecreateCommand
methods.description: Recreates sandbox containers based on specified options, with confirmation and filtering.

methods.name: validateRecreateOptions
methods.description: Validates recreate options ensuring only one of --all, --session, or --agent is specified.

methods.name: fetchAndFilterContainers
methods.description: Fetches and filters sandbox containers and browsers based on session or agent criteria.

methods.name: createAgentMatcher
methods.description: Creates a filter function to match containers or browsers by agent ID.

methods.name: confirmRecreate
methods.description: Prompts user for confirmation before recreating containers.

methods.name: removeContainers
methods.description: Removes filtered sandbox containers and browsers, tracking success and failure counts.

methods.name: removeContainer
methods.description: Attempts to remove a container or browser, logs success or failure.
